summary: Planned ~240,000-gsf, 250-room waterfront hotel site incorporating the retained Unit 3 Power Block; as of May 2025 the developer said the hotel 'could be a decade away' and proposed an interim park (Prequel Park) on the land instead.

milestones.text: Port memo (Item 13B) describes the project's program including a 240,000 gsf hotel (250 rooms)

Developer Enrique Landa says the hotel approved for this site is 'a decade away' given the slow recovery of San Francisco's hospitality sector, and proposes an interim waterfront park (Prequel Park) using the Unit 3/Stack area in the meantime
Completion expected: Block 9's hotel is not named in any Phase 1-3 block list found and the developer said in May 2025 the hotel is 'a decade away'; only the whole-project buildout target applies
milestones.basis_note: Whole-project buildout target: the October 2020 Phase 1 and Phasing Plan Amendment's final Phase 3 'wrapping up construction in late 2035' per SocketSite (Oct 9, 2020); Block 9 has no assigned phase in any source found, and the developer's own May 2025 'a decade away' estimate (i.e., roughly mid-2030s) is consistent with, but not more specific than, this whole-project target.

milestones.text: Board of Supervisors approves the Potrero Power Station project and Development Agreement (Ordinance No. 62-20, Board File 200040), the entitlement that first names Block 9 as a development block under the adopted Design for Development's Land Use Table; the Development Agreement's own effective date is May 25, 2020, distinct from the D4D's own February 26, 2020 final-document date

facts.value: Hotel and/or Residential (D4D final Table 3.1.1: Residential is Permitted; Hotel is Permitted per note 10, unlike most other blocks where Hotel is Not Permitted; Laboratory and Life Science uses are Not Permitted)

The D4D final's Figure 6.2.3 shows a separate 'Block 9 Building Configurations' inset with two alternate massings, 'WITH UNIT 3' and 'WITHOUT UNIT 3', with callouts including 177 ft MAX, 110 ft MAX, 102 ft MAX, 85 ft, 65 ft and 35 ft (with-Unit-3 option) and 125 ft / 85 ft (without-Unit-3 option); Standard 6.2.1 separately states that if Unit 3 is demolished, the height limit for Block 9 would be 125/85 feet

Unit 3 Power Block (128-ft tall steel-frame boiler structure, highest point 143 ft at the elevator shaft, plus a 40-ft tall turbine-generator-condenser structure and a four-story concrete control room building) and the adjacent 300-ft Boiler Stack (mapped separately in this dataset as potrero_the_stack)

'Only one rooftop bar shall be permitted on Block 9' under the adopted D4D -- the origin of the single-rooftop-bar cap for the whole 29-acre project that the developer sought to remove in its 2026 Development Agreement amendment request (see the Station A/Block 15 and other block records for that amendment)

open_questions: No source found stating a developer, architect, hotel brand/operator, or construction cost for the Block 9 hotel.

No design review approval or construction-start date found for Block 9; the 2024 annual compliance report's only mention of Block 9 is site photos of 'Block 9 / Unit 3' as of December 2024, with no described construction activity.
Whether Unit 3 will ultimately be retained or demolished as part of the hotel project is not settled in any source found; the D4D provides for both configurations.

No phase-specific schedule found for the Block 9 hotel; the added expected-completion milestone therefore uses only the whole-project buildout target (2035, SocketSite Oct 2020), not a hotel-specific date.
